public_api_precommit_oracle.copy: Accept only source-issued actual-to-formal T Copy after real call at same source-owner/world/nominal T TypeId and same original field child; old/new/sibling values must match oracle
public_api_precommit_oracle.layout: H completed known layout stable, full prefix, same source-owner and TypeId before/after; reject unknown and numeric-only equal IDs
forgeries: replayed body receipt or wrong call subject
clone failure or fail-at-N retained state
public_api_precommit_oracle.partial: H+T --check valid; C17 unsupported CLI4, stdout length zero, --emit-c17-to sentinel unchanged; no mixed native positive
public_api_precommit_oracle.resource: rollback, deterministic fail-at-N, retry on same canonical semantic context; no leaked roots, functions, nominal layouts or issued receipts; failures cannot be silently green

limitations: Finite semantic oracle only; physical allocation free counts are not verified by --check; raw validator forgery may need separate R-owned C tests where public interface exists
